mapping_request.instructions: Map records to slots for ONE class each - only edges you can justify from the record's prose. You classify; you do NOT decide sufficiency, coverage or maturity. Output the JSON shape in `schema`; the coverage run validates it and refuses unknown records/slots or classes the record does not carry.
